title: LTCL of Rs 40,000 from events in FY 2024-25 (return on time) absorbed by LTCG of Rs 2.05 lakh in FY 2025-26
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.70 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.108 [secondary mapping, not verified]): s.70(2) a short-term capital loss may be set off against any other capital gain, short-term or long-term, of the same year; s.70(3) a long-term capital loss only against long-term capital gain

Income-tax Act 1961 s.74 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.111 [secondary mapping, not verified]): the net capital-gains loss of a year is carried forward to the following assessment year; (1)(a) a short-term loss 'shall be set off' against any capital gain of that year; (1)(b) a long-term loss only against long-term capital gain; (1)(c) the balance is carried on; (2) not for more than eight assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year for which it was first computed

Income-tax Act 1961 s.80 (Income-tax Act 2025 s.121 [secondary mapping, not verified]) with s.139(3) and s.139(1): a capital loss is carried forward and set off under s.74 only if it was determined in a return filed within the time allowed by s.139(1)

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: 12.5 % on long-term capital gains 'exceeding one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees' for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024; the gains are those included in total income, i.e. after the s.70 / s.74 set-off
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2025 s.2)
derivation: FY 2024-25 (fy 2025): no gain to absorb it -> tax 0.00, exemption_used 0.00, losses_carried_long 40,000.00. Return for fy 2025 filed on time -> carried forward; last_fy 2025 + 8 = 2033.
FY 2025-26 (fy 2026): s.74(1)(b) sets the brought-forward LTCL off: 2,05,000 - 40,000 = 1,65,000.00. bf_set_off_long 40,000.00.
Ledger: origin 2025 long, amount 40,000.00, remaining 0.00, last_fy 2033, used.
